subject: Cheeky prices!
author: ZombieTron
body:
I'm sorry... £3+ for one car???? holy crap! I can't believe they are charging so much for the Jansen.

The other cars individually are about what I thought the individual cars would cost, but the price of the Jansen just takes the biscuit. £6.29 for the full pack... that's only 4 cars.. hmmm, I was quite happy to pay a £5 for each car pack.

This sets the precedent for the other car packs, if they are all £6+ and you get them all you are looking at £18+ before you even add the Island and cops and robbers packs, and if you have the party pack too it will end up costing the same.. if not more then the full game costs.

I wonder what the Xbox MS points equivalents are?

It makes it feel like a bargain now as it is cheaper then on PS3! 💰 🙂

subject: ps3 gt nighthawk trophy
author: legoman-D
body:
Is anyone else having trouble getting the 3x boost trophy with the GT Nighthawk? I tried online & offline, got some huge chains but no trophy. Got the other 3 trophies no problem. It could be a bug or I am a complete idiot & did not understand the requirements for the trophy. Both equally possible.

Also, quite interesting to see some 360 kids got their hands on the other packs (toys & boost specials). Are they still available or did sombody do a bad at microsoft hq?

subject: OK, here's a work around for
author: legoman-D
body:
OK, here's a work around for ps3 users wanting the trophy:

Back up save game with xmb util, start new game, get in gt nihgthawk, gain trophy, quit game, copy your old save back over to the ps3 with the util.

It seems the game thinks you already have that trophy for some reason - there's some issue related to the dave file anyway. Hope that helps!
